guideOverviewDesc.message: Multilingual Live Annotation adds AI-powered annotations to any webpage text in real time. Simply hover, select, or right-click text to get instant translations and explanations. The extension works with Chrome's built-in AI (Gemini Nano) for offline use, or any OpenAI-compatible API for more powerful models. All conversation history and vocabulary are saved locally in your browser.

guideAnnotationDesc.message: Three trigger modes are available: Hover mode activates automatically when you move your cursor over a word. Select mode annotates text you drag-select with your mouse. Right-click mode only activates when you explicitly right-click selected text — ideal to avoid accidental triggers. You can also press Alt+A to annotate the currently selected text from any mode. In all modes, right-clicking selected text always works.

guideChatDesc.message: The Chat tab opens a full AI conversation panel. Your conversation history is automatically saved and organized into sessions accessible from the sidebar. You can save any AI response as a favorite using the star button. Deep Think mode (the lightbulb button) prompts the AI to show its full step-by-step reasoning before answering. Voice input is available via the microphone button.

guideChromeAIDesc.message: Chrome Built-in AI runs the Gemini Nano model locally on your device — no internet connection or API key required. You need Chrome 138 or later and must enable the experimental flags below. After enabling the flags, restart Chrome and download the model from chrome://components. Once set up, the AI is completely free and works offline.
